aboutStory.lead: Every great beginning starts with a single small step.
paragraphs: Alpha Glow began on August 4, 2025, with an Instagram page and a single goal: turning creativity into valuable services for businesses.

In the first three months, despite continuous efforts, we did not achieve the results we expected. Instead of stopping, we decided to study the market more closely, analyze trending content, and find fresh ways to showcase our work.
This path led us to a pivotal shift: creating authentic, creative content using our own laptop desk, hands, and voice—an approach that allowed us to present our work in a distinctively different way.
In November 2025, we began working more seriously on this method, and on December 7, 2025, we relaunched Alpha Glow's activities with this new approach.
Just two weeks later, we landed our first project—a result that proved shifting strategy and persevering can transform the trajectory of a business.
Three months later, we added printing and advertising services to our operations; a sector that gradually grew to become one of Alpha Glow's core areas of activity.

Today, Alpha Glow continues its journey in graphic design, branding and visual identity, web design, and printing and advertising services—driven by the same initial belief that every brand deserves a distinctive identity and a professional presence.
aboutStory.closing: This is not the end of the story yet; Alpha Glow is still growing, learning, and building!

mission.title: Our Mission
